label: M1 undo applies the AFTER state instead of the before state
M2 the before-state is captured AFTER the edit is applied
M3 redo re-derives the edit instead of replaying the recorded after-state
M4 setDefinition reports every assignment as an effective change
M5 an invalid definition is assigned and left in place
M6 clone drops the ID, so a redone create cannot be re-inserted
M7 removing a local control removes every control on the same feature
M8 the mesh is not invalidated when the sizing intent changes
M9 a boundary-set rename invalidates the mesh (precision lost)
M10 findMeshControl trusts the ID instead of checking the object's type
M11 a failed generation discards the mesh it could not replace
M12 the redo branch is not discarded when a new command is executed
